title: R24 TABLESTYLE border type, invisibility and spacing

source.specification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.101.4
source.finding: Border type group 91 defines Single=1 and Double=2; group 93 is invisibility 0/1; group 40 is double-line spacing.

implementation.behavior: The AC1024 TABLESTYLE writer admits border types 1/2, invisibility 0/1 and finite nonnegative double-line spacing, keeping existing lineweight, color, linetype, edge identity and other profile checks.

validation.result: Final build passed; focused CTest passed 1/1. Generated ASCII/Binary controls verify group-91/93/40 placement and typed readback for double/invisible borders, refuse border type 3, invisibility 2 and negative spacing with destination preservation, then retry on the same adapter.

qualificationLimits: Only finite nonnegative spacing is admitted; lineweight remains the existing ByBlock profile.
Generated codec controls do not qualify independent producer wire behavior or native border rendering.
No whole-file DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
